race.comment: JIMMYINTHEJUNGLE (2) was well in the betting at Toowoomba last time out and didn't let supporters down with a solid victory. Gets a stack of weight relief with the 3kg claim and maps ideally for this sprint journey from gate three. Can go back-to-back. MISHANI EXTREME (3) has won two from three around this circuit and is another to get some weight off. Can make his presence felt. VIN SANTO (9) returned in fine fashion with a strong Sunny Coast win and winning rider Brooker retains the mount. In the mix. The well-related COINCIDE (4) (half to 2xG1 winner Converge) has put back-to-back wins together and shouldn't be discounted lightly.
